anbindung.rechnername-oder-ip-adresse: Enter a host name or IP address, e.g. db.
anbindung.name-der-datenbank-angeben: Enter the name of the database, e.g. dms.
anbindung.benutzer-der-datenbank-angeben: Enter the database user, e.g. dms.
anbindung.den-rechner-gibt-es: The host “{host}” doesn’t exist in the network. Is the database container called something else? In the Compose template it is called “db”.
anbindung.der-datenbank-server-ist: The database server {host}:{port} can’t be reached. Is the database container running, and is the port right (usually 5432)?
anbindung.das-passwort-fuer-den: The password for the user “{benutzer}” is wrong. It is in the Compose file or the .env (POSTGRES_PASSWORD or DB_PASSWORD).
anbindung.der-benutzer-darf-sich: The user “{benutzer}” may not sign in (unknown or not admitted by the server). In the Compose template it is called “dms”.
anbindung.die-datenbank-gibt-es: The database “{datenbank}” doesn’t exist on the server yet.
anbindung.in-dieser-datenbank-gibt: There is no Ablago data in this database yet. After the restart, setup begins there from scratch – please confirm.
db.dms-db-verbindungen-ist: DMS_DB_VERBINDUNGEN={roh} isn’t a number from {VERBINDUNGEN_MIN} to {VERBINDUNGEN_MAX} and is ignored.
db.diese-datenbank-stammt-von: This database comes from a newer version of Ablago (unknown migration {unbekannt}).
db.bitte-diese-oder-eine: {wert}Please use this or a newer version – going back to an older version is only possible via a backup from before the update.
einrichtung.bitte-einen-namen-angeben: Please enter a name, e.g. “The Smith family”.
einrichtung.der-name-darf-hoechstens: The name may have at most {MANDANT_MAX} characters.
einrichtungscode.zu-viele-falsche-einric: Too many wrong setup codes. Please try again in 10 minutes.
einrichtungscode.nur-heimnetz: Without a setup code, Ablago can only be set up from the home network. Set it up in the home network or start it with a setup code (DMS_EINRICHTUNGSCODE not set to “aus”).
einrichtungsdatei.was-der-einrichtungsas: What the setup assistant has collected – without passwords and without the key. Format version 1.
einrichtungsdatei.verbindung-zu-postgres: Connection to PostgreSQL. Only applies as long as Ablago has no database yet.
einrichtungsdatei.name-der-ablage-z: Name of the library, e.g. “The Example family”.
einrichtungsdatei.dein-konto-die-person: Your account: the person who sets up Ablago. They get “Full administration” and also work in the library. Until 0.192 the section was called “administrator” – Ablago still reads that.
einrichtungsdatei.pakete-aus-dem-offizie: Packages from the official catalogue, each the newest matching version. If the list is missing, you choose in the assistant.
einrichtungsdatei.mitgelieferte-automati: Included automations: key → switched on (true) or off (false).
einrichtungsdatei.adresse-von-ablago-fue: Ablago’s address for links in emails.
einrichtungsmodus.interner-fehler-detail: Internal error. Details are in the container’s log.
einrichtungsmodus.anfrage-ohne-kennung-d: Request without the interface’s identifier rejected.
einrichtungsmodus.ablago-ist-noch-nicht: Ablago isn’t set up yet: the connection to the database is missing. Open Ablago in the browser to start the setup assistant.
erweiterungen.liegt-im-schema-und: {name} is in the schema {schema} and would be lost in a restore
erweiterungen.pg-trgm-fehlt-keine: pg_trgm missing: no typo search, word parts without index
erweiterungen.unaccent-fehlt-umlaute-fal: unaccent missing: Ablago folds umlauts itself
fehlermeldungen.ein-bild-darf-hoechstens: An image may be at most {wert} MB.
fehlermeldungen.bilder-bitte-als-png: Please provide images as PNG, JPEG or WebP.
konsole.unter-gibt-es-keine: There is no active person with “Full administration” under {als}.
konsole.es-gibt-noch-keine: There is no active person with “Full administration” yet. Set up Ablago in the browser (or use the emergency access).
mandant.haushalt-id-ist-nicht: HAUSHALT_ID is no longer needed and can be removed from the Compose file. {haushalt}
mandant.haushalt-id-weicht-von: HAUSHALT_ID differs from the household’s ID and is ignored; it can be removed from the Compose file.
mandant.haushalt-id-wurde-uebernommen: HAUSHALT_ID was taken over and can be removed from the Compose file. {haushalt}
messung.vor-dur-app-dur: vor;dur={d}, app;dur={d2}, db;dur={d3};desc="{dbAnzahl}", rechte;dur={d4}, json;dur={d5}, gesamt;dur={d6}
messung.ms-gesamt-warten-vor: {r} ms total · waiting before the handler {r2} · database {r3} ({dbAnzahl}) · permissions {r4} · preparation {r5} · JSON {r6}
protokoll.debug-modus-nach-einer: Debug-Modus nach einer Stunde automatisch ausgeschaltet
repo.die-mappe-hat-sich: The folder has changed in the meantime.
system.version-nicht-in-der: Version not found in the list.
system.was-neu-ist-steht: What’s new is in the releases on GitHub. To update, pull the image again.
system.auf-main: There are newer changes on main that aren’t in a stable version yet (state {sha} of {datumDe}).
system.auf-main-anzahl_one: There is {anzahl} newer change on main that isn’t in a stable version yet (state {sha} of {datumDe}).
system.auf-main-anzahl_other: There are {anzahl} newer changes on main that aren’t in a stable version yet (state {sha} of {datumDe}).
system.ohne-commit-kennung-im: Without a commit identifier in the image (DMS_COMMIT) the state can’t be compared.
wartung.ablago-wird-gerade-gewartet: Ablago is being maintained{wert}.{ende} Please try again later.
wartung.das-erwartete-ende-ist: The expected end isn’t a valid point in time.
wartung.der-beginn-ist-kein: The start isn’t a valid point in time.
wartung.der-beginn-liegt-in: The start is in the past. For immediately please use “Lock right now”.
wartung.der-beginn-darf-hoechstens: The start may be at most 24 hours in the future – from the announcement on, only people who may administer can sign in.
wartung.das-erwartete-ende-muss: The expected end must be after the start.
wartung.die-vorlaufzeit-muss-zwischen: The lead time must be between 0 and 1440 minutes.
einrichtungsdatei.beruflich: The Library is also used for work (attribute “used for work”, default no): folder types then show their work-related fields and sections, and the Workbench starts with the “Self-employed” level.
einrichtungsdatei.nutzung: What Ablago is used for: privat (home), beruflich (work) or beides (both). Work and both set the attribute “used for work” and preselect suitable packages in the wizard; if missing, the wizard asks.
einrichtungsdatei.organisation: Your organisation (only for work and both): name required, address, email and phone optional. “Set up now” creates it as your own organisation with the Basis package.
extern.pausiert: AI features paused until {datum}: the monthly budget for AI services has been reached. An administrator can change the budget under Workbench → System health → AI costs.
